assetReuse.note: Real local copies are reused across 6/48/320 canvas nodes and 4/24/160 clips. Node/clip count stress is not 160 unique video decoders or unique files.

latencyBoundary: Trusted input to specific visible state receipt; independent first feedback and full TTI are not measured.
cpuPolicy: Incomplete CPU collector samples have all-window CPU and RSS values null here; partial numbers remain in immutable raw and diagnostic audits. Full median requires 5/5 valid formal samples.
comparability: Same production commit, fixture owner revision, instrumentation and per-cell repetitions. Heavy/format use independent pair processes; earlier small/typical long-process residency differs, so ratios are descriptive, not a controlled scale-only causal experiment.
tracePolicy: Actual trace mark quality is retained; typical last 7 stored samples lack trace markers.
